Purpose and exclusions

Authored configuration for Deployment, zone allocation and operational recovery. Runtime state never resides on this instance.

Never bypass the declared rule owner, mutate an authored definition at runtime, trust a client completion claim, or infer a compiled implementation from this page.

Creation and configuration

  1. Select DA_Deployment_Development in Content Browser; set DefinitionId to a stable domain ID, then set the fields in the linked feature contract.
  2. Assign this instance to the consuming native owner through its Blueprint child/defaults or catalog; a content file that is never assigned has no runtime effect.

Required sequence: create native prerequisites -> actual build -> child/data creation -> configure -> assign to listed consumer -> save -> run named fixture. A compiled shell without its consumer assignment is not feature completion.

Lifecycle and cleanup

  1. Author and validate stable definition/frame/field identity before use; load through declared references at readiness.
  2. Consumers may cache read-only references for their world/session lifetime; do not mutate the shared definition or place player quantities on it.
  3. On reimport/version change validate compatibility and migrate persistent IDs deliberately. Missing required rules fail closed; missing cosmetic layers use documented fallback.
  4. World/pawn teardown releases runtime references; persistent records retain IDs and versions only. Reconnect resolves the same definition without replaying grants.

Concrete player-to-authority flow

Participation in Deployment, zone allocation and operational recovery. Rule owner: URPGZoneHeartbeatComponent. This asset’s role is Authored configuration for Deployment, zone allocation and operational recovery. Runtime state never resides on this instance.

  1. Build a versioned client and dedicated-server package from the same pinned engine/plugin/content revision; keep symbols and server logs privately.
  2. Start PostgreSQL and one authenticated backend, apply checked migrations, then start two zone processes with separate IDs/ports and service credentials supplied outside content.
  3. Each zone registers its zone/catalog/build and begins admitting players only after definitions, persistence adapter and safe spawns are ready.
  4. Allocator chooses a compatible zone with reserved capacity; it must count in-flight reservations to avoid overfilling.
  5. On maintenance, stop new admissions/economic starts, settle commands, snapshot/fence sessions and offer safe reconnect/transfer. Terminate only after the drain policy or explicit failure handling.
  6. Backups include database and required server configuration metadata; restore to an isolated environment and reconcile ledger/inventory/quest/session invariants before declaring the backup usable.

Named fixture and acceptance

Fixture: L_LoadTest / Zone_A and Zone_B / backend staging database. Configure this asset at its first phase and run the linked phase recipe. Actual result: not run in Unreal/backend during documentation generation.

Stimulus / expected result
Heartbeat lost -> allocator stops new reservations; existing session authority is determined by lease/fencing, not heartbeat alone.
Zone full -> ZoneFull with retry/alternate compatible destination; do not disconnect source before a valid handoff plan.
Database unavailable -> economic actions reject/pend safely; no client-local fallback save.
Restore older database -> invalidate old tickets/epochs and reconcile acknowledged operations against recovery policy; never silently replay client receipts as grants.

Record expected/observed separately. Reopen the concrete map consumer; inspect authoritative state, stable IDs/revisions and UI. Static link checks cannot satisfy this gameplay test.

Common mistakes and staged limits

Do not put mutable stock, current health, inventory quantities or player quest progress on a shared Data Asset. A soft reference still needs validation and readiness.

Do not build later references as empty shells in an earlier phase. Source-derived art rows remain blocked by the missing ZIP; plugin API bindings remain blocked by installed-source verification. Placeholder visuals and proposed tuning are explicitly not production proof.
